## DPStyleARFootwearRendererInput.left property

Tracking data for left-foot footwear rendering. - detected: Whether the left footwear has been detected in the camera frame. - trans: The translation (position) of the left foot target. - quat: The quaternion representing the left foot target orientation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
left: {
        detected: boolean;
        trans: number[];
        quat: number[];
    };
```
